title: VipPerkListResult
description: vip.perk-list-result@1: the answer of vip.perk.list on OpenVibe.VIP. GET /api/v1/perks?creator=&network=&retired= → { perks }: a creator's active perks plus the network's (network=0 leaves those out), ordered creator first then by name; retired=1 adds retired perks for the creator, staff or a service holding vip.perk.list. 404 vip.creator_not_found (problem+json) when creator names nobody.
